questions.question: Why is nanoindentation particularly useful for thin films and coatings?

answers.c: It allows very shallow, localized testing

explanations.a: Nanoindentation applies very small loads and shallow penetration depths, making it ideal for measuring properties of thin films and coatings without substrate interference.
